dict.string: Bytepet looks at which website is open in your browser so your pet knows when you're distracted, and closes distracting tabs during strict focus sessions.
Bytepet counts the files on your Desktop. A messy Desktop makes your pet poop.
Bytepet counts the files in Downloads. A messy Downloads folder makes your pet poop.
Bytepet can read your calendar so your pet stays quiet during meetings.
Bytepet can turn your Reminders into food for your pet.
